abstract: We introduce a robust, flexible, and easy-to-implement method for estimating the yield curve from treasury securities. Our nonparametric method learns the discount curve in a function space that we motivate by economic principles. We show in an extensive empirical study on U.S. Treasury securities that our method strongly dominates all parametric and nonparametric benchmarks. It achieves substantially smaller out-of-sample yield and pricing errors while being robust to outliers and data selection choices. We attribute the superior performance to the optimal trade-off between flexibility and smoothness, which positions our method as the new standard for yield curve estimation. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01401 .
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种稳健、灵活且易于实施的国债收益率曲线估计方法。我们的非参数方法在一个由经济原理驱动的函数空间中学习贴现曲线。我们通过对美国国债进行的大量实证研究表明，我们的方法显著优于所有参数和非参数基准。它在实现显著更小的样本外收益率和定价误差的同时，对异常值和数据选择具有稳健性。我们将这一优越表现归因于灵活性与平滑性之间的最优权衡，这使我们的方法成为收益率曲线估计的新标准。本文由金融领域编辑Agostino Capponi接收。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01401获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Stripping the Discount Curve—A Robust Machine Learning Approach
title_zh: 剥离贴现曲线——一种稳健的机器学习方法
